title: Cosignature
description: A witness's signature over a tree head's canonical text. A witness issues one only for a tree head that extends the last one it cosigned. Other fields are allowed: receipts-log serves each cosignature with treeSize, rootHash, timestamp and receivedAt beside these (its API.md). The signature is v2 only because witnesses sign with Ed25519 only (bin/witness.mjs), and receipts-log checks Ed25519 only.

publicKeyUrl.description: An https URL of at most 2048 characters with no whitespace or control characters, including a final newline. Requiring https is this schema's own rule: receipts-log records any URL of 1–2048 bytes with no control characters.
